shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && ls -la && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | grep -v package-lock | sort

for f in next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx' lib/products.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done; git diff package.json; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rl "cacheComponents" . | head -20; echo ---; find . -iname '*use-cache*' -o -iname '*cache-components*' -o -iname '*cacheLife*' | head

cd /workspace && grep -o "export { cacheLife\|export { cacheTag\|cacheLife as\|cacheTag as\|unstable_cacheLife\|unstable_cacheTag" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u; grep -rn "cacheLife\|cacheTag" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 0.5; done echo "--- EUR"; curl -s 'http://localhost:3123/products/lamp?currency=EUR' | grep -o '

[^<]*

\|EUR [0-9.]*\|USD [0-9.]*\|Stone vase\|Signal Shop collection\|Loading product\|Loading related' | sort | uniq -c echo "--- USD default"; curl -s 'http://localhost:3123/products/vase' | grep -o '

[^<]*

\|EUR [0-9.]*\|USD [0-9.]*\|Brass lamp' | sort | uniq -c echo "--- unknown slug status:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' 'http://localhost:3123/products/nope' echo "--- timing: first vs second request (cached getProduct)"; for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_starttransfer} %{time_total}\n' 'http://localhost:3123/products/lamp?currency=EUR'; done

curl -s 'http://localhost:3123/products/nope' | grep -o 'This page could not be found\|404\|

[^<]*

' | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- streamed chunk order (EUR):"; curl -sN 'http://localhost:3123/products/lamp?currency=EUR' | tr -d '\n' | grep -o 'Loading product…\|EUR 110.40\|Loading related products…\|Stone vase' | awk '!seen[$0]++'; pkill -f 'next start' ; true
